Visitor skips at element_start level removes entire subtree

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitElementStart(NodeContext ctx) {        return new VisitResult.Skip();    }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<div><h1>Title</h1><p>Content</p></div>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
